UK temperatures are already 1.4°C above the historic norm and heading for a 2°C rise within two decades, requiring the government to address the unequal impacts of climate change.

stories.title: Spending watchdog warns £38bn cost of Sizewell C nuclear plant is ‘risky’
stories.summary: The UK National Audit Office warned that the £38 billion Sizewell C nuclear plant in Suffolk faces "significant uncertainty" in costs and may not deliver net benefits to households until at least 2064. The watchdog said potential benefits are "considerable but uncertain" while risks are "immediate, substantial and borne by the public."

stories.title: Only 4 of Hong Kong’s 110,000 subdivided homes put up for seal of approval
stories.summary: Only four of Hong Kong's estimated 110,000 subdivided homes have been submitted for certification approval in the two and a half months since a new law took effect to phase out substandard living spaces. Three applications came from a single landlord, Hayson Chan Hin-hay, chairman of the Hong Kong Basic Housing Units Operators Association.

stories.title: Nio slams EV price wars in China as costs surge, defying cuts by rival Li Auto
stories.summary: Chinese electric vehicle maker Nio pushed back against ongoing EV price wars in China, with senior vice president Ji Huaqiang arguing that carmakers must prioritize profitability as raw material costs rise. This stance contrasts with rival Li Auto's approach to pricing amid intensifying domestic competition.

stories.title: Trump says US may need to hit Iran again
stories.summary: President Trump indicated the United States may need to conduct another military strike against Iran. He disclosed he was approximately one hour away from ordering an attack before deciding to postpone it.

stories.title: NATO is starting to consider Hormuz deployment to protect ships
stories.summary: NATO has begun initial discussions on a potential naval deployment to the Strait of Hormuz to protect commercial shipping. The proposal has not yet received the unanimous support required from alliance members.

stories.title: Board of Peace urges countries that promised funds for Gaza to pay up
stories.summary: The Board of Peace urged countries that pledged funds for Gaza reconstruction to fulfill their commitments, acknowledging a gap between the $17 billion pledged and actual donations. Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich reportedly rejected a US request to transfer withheld Palestinian Authority funds to a US-led body.

stories.title: Ukraine pursuing active defense: AFU Chief names hottest frontline sectors
stories.summary: Ukraine's Armed Forces Commander reported that Russian forces are conducting intensive offensive operations across several key frontline sectors. Ukrainian Defense Forces are employing an active defense strategy involving counterattacks and offensive operations where possible.

stories.title: China’s new worldview and the future of global politics
stories.summary: A commentary examines China's efforts to reshape the global order through its initiatives and critiques of the existing international system. Beijing is positioning itself as a leader of multilateralism, seeking to advance a new worldview in global politics.

stories.title: JD Vance says US seeks to ‘reset’ relations with Iran
stories.summary: U.S. Vice President JD Vance said Washington seeks to reset its relationship with Iran after decades of hostility. He added that the U.S. would not accept any agreement permitting Iran to obtain a nuclear weapon.

stories.title: Israel has lost its morality, Tucker Carlson says in first interview with Israeli media
stories.summary: Commentator Tucker Carlson, in his first interview with Israeli media, said Israel has lost its morality. He cited civilian casualties from Israel's recent wars against Hamas, Hezbollah, and Iran as evidence.

stories.title: US imposes fresh sanctions on Iranian exchange house, shadow fleet vessels
stories.summary: The Trump administration imposed new sanctions on an Iranian foreign currency exchange house and front companies facilitating transactions for Iranian banks. The measures are part of continued U.S. economic pressure on Tehran.

stories.title: Ukraine at UN Security Council urges nuclear powers not to ignore Russia-Belarus drills
stories.summary: Ukraine's UN representative Andrii Melnyk urged nuclear powers including the UK, France, the US, and China not to ignore joint Russia-Belarus military exercises, raising the issue at the UN Security Council.

stories.title: US House foreign affairs chair warns AI sales to China could make America a ‘loser’
stories.summary: House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast warned that selling AI technology to China could make the United States the "loser" in strategic competition. His remarks followed President Trump's return from Beijing, where AI was discussed.

stories.title: Trump leads media tour of ballroom building site as Congress balks at $1bn price tag
stories.summary: President Trump led a media tour of the White House ballroom construction site, which is being built on the former East Wing grounds. The administration requested $1 billion from Congress for security costs, but the Senate parliamentarian raised procedural objections.

stories.title: Putin visits China after Trump as Moscow seeks to shore up ties - analysis
stories.summary: Russian President Putin's visit to China shortly after Trump's Beijing trip is seen as an effort by Moscow to shore up ties with Beijing and prevent China from drifting toward the United States.

stories.title: US Senate votes to advance resolution to curb Trump’s Iran war powers
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate voted 50-47 to advance a war powers resolution that would require President Trump to obtain congressional authorization to continue military operations in Iran. Four Republicans joined nearly all Senate Democrats in the vote, marking the first time the measure has advanced.

stories.title: Hezbollah says it launched fresh attacks on Israeli forces in south Lebanon
stories.summary: Hezbollah announced it carried out a series of attacks on Israeli forces in southern Lebanon, striking troops near Deir Siryan with artillery, rockets, and drones. A separate attack targeted Israeli forces in Beit Leef with artillery fire.

stories.title: Israel far-right finance minister says ICC prosecutor seeks arrest warrant against him
stories.summary: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich stated that the International Criminal Court prosecutor has sought an arrest warrant against him. Smotrich blamed the Palestinian Authority and announced Israel would respond by ordering the evacuation of the Palestinian Bedouin community of Khan al-Ahmar in the occupied West Bank.

stories.title: Govt invites expressions of interest for sale of three major Discos
stories.summary: Pakistan's Privatisation Commission invited expressions of interest from local and international investors for the sale of three electricity distribution companies: Faisalabad Electric Supply Company, Gujranwala Electric Power Company, and Islamabad Electric Supply Company. The EOI deadline falls in the first quarter of the next fiscal year.

stories.title: US lobbied Saudi Arabia to release funds for Gaza 'Board of Peace' amid cash crunch
stories.summary: The United States lobbied Saudi Arabia to release funding for a Gaza governance body known as the "Board of Peace" amid a cash shortage. Israeli military operations and disputes over Palestinian representation have complicated Gulf financing efforts.

stories.title: G-7 finance ministers vow cooperation to face ‘heightened risks’
stories.summary: G7 finance ministers issued a joint statement highlighting multiple and complex global challenges requiring coordinated responses. The group vowed cooperation to address what they described as heightened risks.

stories.title: Woman dies after falling into uncovered manhole in New York
stories.summary: A 56-year-old woman died after falling into an uncovered maintenance hole near Fifth Avenue and East 52nd Street in Midtown Manhattan on Monday night. She had parked her vehicle next to the opening and fell in after exiting. Authorities are investigating.

stories.title: Israeli far-right Minister Smotrich says ICC prosecutor seeks his arrest
stories.summary: Israeli far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich stated that the International Criminal Court prosecutor is seeking his arrest. Britain and four other nations imposed sanctions on Smotrich last year, accusing him of inciting violence against Palestinians in the West Bank.

stories.title: US to let DR Congo football team in for World Cup despite Ebola restrictions
stories.summary: The United States has granted an exception to its Ebola-related travel ban—which bars non-Americans who recently visited DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan—to allow the DR Congo national football team to enter the country for the World Cup.

stories.title: Ukrainian offensive actions surpass Russian attacks for first time, Syrskyi says
stories.summary: Ukrainian Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi reported that Ukrainian offensive actions on the battlefield surpassed Russian attacks for the first time during a recent day of fighting.

stories.title: Why China Is Cracking Down on Elite Education
stories.summary: Chinese authorities are conducting a crackdown on elite education institutions across the country. The campaign is reportedly driven by concerns over corruption and a push toward egalitarian principles in the education system.

stories.title: Qatar says U.S.-Iran negotiations need 'more time'
stories.summary: Qatar's foreign ministry indicated that U.S.-Iran negotiations require additional time. President Trump stated he had suspended a planned military strike after leaders of Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates urged him to allow diplomacy to proceed.

stories.title: Preliminary vote to dissolve Knesset set for Wednesday as legislative agenda cleared
stories.summary: A preliminary vote to dissolve the Israeli Knesset is scheduled for Wednesday after the legislative agenda was cleared. Opposition leader Yair Golan of the Democrats party reportedly urged opposition leaders to show unity ahead of the vote, with elections likely before an October 27 deadline.

stories.title: Putin is pushing for a blockbuster oil and gas deal in China. Will he get it?
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin is visiting China seeking major oil and gas deals, arriving shortly after U.S. President Trump's own visit to Beijing yielded limited trade results. The visits underscore U.S.-Russia-China energy and trade competition.

stories.title: US authorities say missionary who contracted Ebola en route to Germany
stories.summary: A U.S. missionary who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is being transported to Germany for treatment. The World Health Organization reports the outbreak's death toll has reached 134.

stories.title: Knesset dissolution bill vote set for Wednesday amid coalition crisis over haredi draft bill
stories.summary: The Israeli Knesset has scheduled a vote on a dissolution bill for Wednesday amid a coalition crisis over haredi military draft legislation. The coalition is rushing to fast-track controversial bills ahead of a potential dissolution.

stories.title: One person dead and four in hospital after alleged shooting in Sydney’s south-west
stories.summary: One man died and four others were hospitalized in serious condition after an alleged shooting at a home in Canley Heights, in Sydney's south-west, on Tuesday night. New South Wales police established a crime scene at the location.

stories.title: Muslim-American groups blame mainstreaming of hate speech for mosque shooting
stories.summary: Muslim-American organizations attributed the shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego on May 18, 2026, which killed three people, to the mainstreaming of hate speech. Teenage gunmen carried out the attack, and it is under investigation as a hate crime.

stories.title: US plans to shrink forces available to NATO during crises, sources say
stories.summary: The Trump administration is planning to reduce the pool of U.S. military capabilities designated to support NATO's European allies during a major crisis. The move would shrink the forces available to the alliance in contingency scenarios.

stories.title: Pakistan a net regional stabiliser contributing to peace in the region and beyond: PM Shehbaz
stories.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, addressing faculty and officers at the Command and Staff College in Quetta, described Pakistan as a net regional stabiliser contributing to peace and stability in the broader region.

stories.title: CinC Syrskyi: Russian combat losses far exceed Ukraine’s
stories.summary: Commander-in-Chief Syrskyi stated that Russian combat losses currently exceed Ukrainian losses by approximately 3.5 times overall, with some days seeing Russian killed-in-action figures seven to nine times higher than Ukraine's.

stories.title: US Vice President JD Vance says 'a lot of progress' made in Iran talks
stories.summary: Vice President JD Vance reported significant progress in US-Iran negotiations, saying he had spoken with President Trump. Vance stated the core US demand remains that Iran must never acquire a nuclear weapon.

stories.title: Former governor general and Brisbane’s Anglican archbishop Peter Hollingworth dies at 91
stories.summary: Former Australian Governor General and Anglican Archbishop of Brisbane Peter Hollingworth has died at age 91. Appointed governor general by Prime Minister John Howard in 2001, he resigned over his handling of child sexual abuse cases in the Anglican church.

stories.title: University of Haifa unveils program to help Druze after IDF service
stories.summary: The University of Haifa launched a program to support Druze community members transitioning from IDF service. University President Gur Alroey described it as an expression of gratitude toward Israel's Druze population.

stories.title: Lebanese army chief discusses post-UNIFIL phase with UN official
stories.summary: Lebanese army commander Rudolf Heikel met UN Undersecretary-General for Safety and Security Gilles Michaud at army headquarters in Yarzeh. The talks focused on the security situation in Lebanon and planning for a post-UNIFIL phase, with Michaud praising the Lebanese Armed Forces' stabilization efforts.

stories.title: IDF says strike in southern Gaza killed Hamas operative who invaded Israel on Oct. 7
stories.summary: The Israeli military said it killed a Hamas operative in an airstrike in southern Gaza, identifying him as someone who participated in the October 7 attack on Israel. A separate report found that Hamas used an early 2025 truce period to train new fighters.

stories.title: Malacca Strait could be the next hinge point if Asia isn’t careful
stories.summary: An analysis warns that the Strait of Malacca could become a strategic flashpoint as the Iran-related Hormuz crisis ripples through global energy markets and intensifies competition between the U.S. and China over currency and trade influence.

stories.title: Thousands of protesters demand president’s resignation in Bolivia’s La Paz
stories.summary: Thousands of protesters gathered in La Paz, Bolivia, demanding the president's resignation amid the country's worst economic crisis in four decades. The demonstrations are part of growing nationwide unrest fueled by deteriorating economic conditions.

stories.title: Bessent urges more disruption to Iran's financing, will review US sanctions list
stories.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called on allies in Paris to more aggressively disrupt Iran's financing networks. He also announced plans to review and update the U.S. sanctions list by removing outdated designations to help financial institutions target sophisticated terrorist financing.

stories.title: US Army ignoring safety concerns before Iranian strike led to mass casualty, soldiers say - report
stories.summary: US soldiers have alleged that the Army ignored safety concerns before an Iranian strike that resulted in mass casualties. Major Stephen Ramsbottom told CBS that fallen soldier Master Sergeant Nicole Amor might have survived with more medical personnel and supplies.

stories.title: Russian sanctions waiver extension shows G7 does not agree on everything, EU's Dombrovskis says
stories.summary: EU economy commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis criticized the extension of a waiver on Russian sanctions, noting that G7 members do not agree on all issues. His comments came during the G7 finance ministers' meeting in Paris.

stories.title: Expert: No “mass influx” of labor migrants into Ukraine
stories.summary: Despite social media claims of a mass influx of labor migrants from Asia and Africa into Ukraine, experts say the actual number of foreign workers is significantly lower than pre-invasion levels.

stories.title: Why did Gulf states ask Trump to hold off on Iran strikes? - analysis
stories.summary: Regional analysts say Gulf states urged President Trump to delay strikes on Iran over fears that even limited attacks on Iranian energy or military infrastructure could provoke retaliatory strikes on vital Gulf infrastructure.

stories.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1546: Ukraine’s new glide bomb costs third of US equivalent
stories.summary: On day 1,546 of the Russo-Ukrainian war, reports indicate Ukraine has developed a new glide bomb costing roughly one-third the price of its U.S. equivalent. A joint human rights report found Russia recruits foreign fighters through a deceptive global system.

stories.title: Rubio discusses Strait of Hormuz with UN chief
stories.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio held talks with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on the situation in the Strait of Hormuz. The discussion centered on U.S. efforts to prevent Iran from placing mines and imposing tolls in the waterway, including a proposed UN Security Council resolution.

stories.title: 'Huge mismatch' between Iran's, US' and Gulf States' expectations, analyst says
stories.summary: H. A. Hellyer, Senior Associate Fellow at the Royal United Services Institute in London, told FRANCE 24 that significant gaps exist between Iranian, American, and Gulf Arab states' expectations regarding ongoing negotiations. He noted that Gulf states will have to contend with the consequences of any outcome.

stories.title: US sanctions Iranian foreign currency exchange, international front companies
stories.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department imposed sanctions on an Iranian foreign currency exchange and international front companies. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the action targets Iran's shadow banking system, which facilitates illicit funding transfers for terrorist purposes.

stories.title: Syrian soldier killed, 18 people wounded by car bomb in Damascus
stories.summary: A car bomb exploded outside a Defence Ministry building in Damascus on Tuesday, killing one Syrian soldier and wounding at least 18 people. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.

stories.title: Multilateralsim at work: Eurogroup President on G7 meeting, Europe's priorities and challenges
stories.summary: G7 finance ministers and central bankers concluded two days of meetings in Paris amid the war in Iran and an ongoing energy crisis. Eurogroup President Kyriakos Pierrakakis, representing the 21-member euro area, told FRANCE 24 that participants shared a commitment to multilateral approaches despite some differences.

stories.title: Video shows oil spill on Iranian island after refinery attack last month
stories.summary: Video footage has revealed the environmental impact of an oil spill on Iran's Lavan Island, caused by an attack on the Lavan oil refinery the previous month.

stories.title: US charges 7 Chinese executives and 4 shipping firms linked to container cartel
stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice charged seven Chinese executives and four major shipping container manufacturers with conspiring to restrict supply and fix prices during the Covid-19 pandemic. The companies produce approximately 95% of the world's standard dry shipping containers, and the alleged scheme ran from November 2019 to January 2024.

stories.title: Ukraine increases frontline activity, expands long-range 'sanctions' against Russia in June – Zelensky
stories.summary: President Zelensky announced that Ukraine intensified frontline combat operations and expanded long-range strikes against targets inside Russia during June. He cited positive shifts in battlefield dynamics in Ukraine's favor based on May results.

stories.title: 5 booked for allegedly gang-raping girl in Sindh's Ghotki
stories.summary: Police in Sindh's Ghotki district registered a gang-rape case against five suspects more than two weeks after the alleged assault on a teenage girl. The FIR was filed at Adilpur police station under Pakistan Penal Code provisions carrying penalties of death or life imprisonment.

stories.title: 'It's like the Holocaust': Golders Green gang-beating victim tells 'Post' - interview
stories.summary: A man identified as Ben Yakar was beaten by a gang in Golders Green, London, on Monday morning. London's Metropolitan Police is treating the assault as an antisemitic hate crime but reported no arrests had been made by Monday night.

stories.title: Australia news live: Peter Hollingworth dies aged 91; one dead and four injured in Sydney shooting
stories.summary: Former Australian Governor-General Peter Hollingworth died at age 91; he had resigned over his handling of child sexual abuse cases in the Anglican Church. Separately, one person was killed and four injured in a shooting in Sydney.

stories.title: Space Force names Sandhoo as head of new missile warning/tracking PAE
stories.summary: The U.S. Space Force named Sandhoo as head of the newly established missile warning and tracking Program Acquisition Executive. Sandhoo simultaneously serves as director of the Space Development Agency.

stories.title: European crime gang made BBQ briquettes from toxic ashes: Italian police
stories.summary: Italian police uncovered a European crime scheme that allegedly converted toxic ashes containing illegal levels of pollutants into barbecue briquettes for commercial sale.

stories.title: Thousands of Palestinian patients remain stranded in Gaza awaiting treatment abroad
stories.summary: Thousands of Palestinian patients remain stranded in Gaza awaiting medical treatment abroad. The Palestinian Health Ministry reported that only 29 patients were able to leave through the Rafah crossing with Egypt on a recent day, far below the urgent need.

stories.title: NORTHCOM standing up ‘Nordic Bridge’ to boost US coordination in Arctic
stories.summary: U.S. Northern Command is establishing "Nordic Bridge," a new initiative to enhance American military coordination in the Arctic. NORTHCOM commander Gen. Guillot emphasized defending far from the homeland, with special operations forces playing a key role.

stories.title: Maj. Itamar Sapir killed in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Major Itamar Sapir, deputy commander of a company in Battalion 7008, was killed during operations in southern Lebanon.

stories.title: IDF reservist killed in exchange of fire with Hezbollah in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Israeli Defense Forces reservist Itamar Sapir, 27, was killed in an exchange of fire with a Hezbollah operative in southern Lebanon. The Hezbollah fighter reportedly opened fire from inside a church. Sapir is survived by his wife and one-year-old son.

stories.title: Trump showcases new ‘drone-protected’ White House ballroom
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump gave reporters a tour of the construction site for a new ballroom at the White House, which he described as "drone-protected."

stories.title: Highlights: India, Nordic nations agree to elevate ties to Green Technology and Innovation Strategic Partnership
stories.summary: India and the Nordic nations agreed to elevate their bilateral relationship to a Green Technology and Innovation Strategic Partnership. Prime Minister Narendra Modi departed for Italy on Tuesday after concluding his visit to Norway.

stories.title: Special Operations Forces strike number of targets in Russia's border regions with drones
stories.summary: Fighters of the 73rd Naval Center of Ukraine's Special Operations Forces used FPV drones to strike vehicles, communication antennas, and shelters used by Russian troops in Russia's border regions.

stories.title: Latest Ebola outbreak tough to tackle
stories.summary: The World Health Organization warned that the latest Ebola outbreak is unlikely to end within two months. Separately, a Kenyan transport strike triggered by rising fuel prices linked to the Middle East war was paused after causing four deaths. Pretrial hearings also opened at The Hague for a former Libyan prison commander.

stories.title: Gaza flotilla leader linked to Hamas sanctioned by US Treasury
stories.summary: The US Treasury sanctioned a leader of the Gaza flotilla movement linked to Hamas. The individual participated in the recent Global Sumud Flotilla, which was intercepted by the Israeli Navy on April 29.

stories.title: Somaliland recognises Jerusalem as capital of Israel, will open embassy
stories.summary: Somaliland has recognised Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and announced plans to open an embassy there. Israel will reciprocate by opening an embassy in Hargeisa, deepening ties with the breakaway Horn of Africa region.

stories.title: Slovenia's Janša seeks fourth term after coalition secures majority
stories.summary: Slovenia's right-leaning Slovenian Democratic Party submitted leader Janez Janša's candidacy for prime minister after securing a potential ruling coalition majority. If confirmed, it would be Janša's fourth term as Slovenia's head of government.

stories.title: Thousands under evacuation orders in southern California as wildfire threatens homes
stories.summary: More than 17,000 people were placed under evacuation orders in southern California as the wind-driven Sandy fire threatened homes in the Simi Valley area, about 30 miles northwest of Los Angeles. At least one home was destroyed as hundreds of firefighters battled the blaze.

stories.title: JD Vance urges UK anti-immigration activists to ‘keep on going’
stories.summary: U.S. Vice President JD Vance encouraged anti-immigration activists in the United Kingdom to "keep on going" after tens of thousands attended a rally in London. The event was organized by far-right activist Tommy Robinson.

stories.title: Air Force grounds T-38 fleet after Mississippi mishap
stories.summary: The U.S. Air Force grounded its entire T-38 trainer fleet following a crash in Mississippi on May 12. An operational pause was ordered while the mishap is investigated, with aircraft inspections expected to begin this week.

stories.title: MSF accuses all South Sudan forces of exploiting aid for military objectives
stories.summary: Médecins Sans Frontières accused South Sudan's government of blocking humanitarian access to opposition-controlled areas. The aid group said all parties in the ongoing conflict were exploiting humanitarian aid for political and military objectives.

stories.title: More than 15,800 people killed in Russia’s all-out war on Ukraine: UN
stories.summary: The United Nations reported that more than 15,800 people, including nearly 800 children, have been killed in Ukraine since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022.

stories.title: Hamas leadership calls for kidnapping of IDF soldiers following death penalty law passing - report
stories.summary: Hamas leadership reportedly called for the kidnapping of Israeli soldiers following the passage of a death penalty law in Israel. In an internal document, Hamas described the legislation as "fascist" and urged its military wing to escalate operations.

stories.title: Threat of Russian offensive from Belarus is real – Syrskyi
stories.summary: Ukrainian Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi warned that the threat of a Russian offensive from Belarus is real, noting Russia has twice as many brigades and regiments as Ukraine and the front line already exceeds 1,200 kilometers.

stories.title: New drone‑mounted robot transforms high‑voltage maintenance in Israel
stories.summary: Israel Electric Corporation introduced a drone-mounted robot system for high-voltage power line maintenance, replacing helicopter-based operations to improve crew safety and reduce costs.

stories.title: Billionaire Trump donor in line to make millions from Thames Water bid
stories.summary: Billionaire Paul Singer, a major Trump donor, stands to profit from a rescue deal being negotiated for Thames Water, the UK's largest water company. Singer's hedge fund is a leading creditor in a consortium in talks with the British government over the company's £17.6 billion debt.

stories.title: Captured Hamas document shows how group used Gaza ceasefire to train new terrorists
stories.summary: A captured Hamas document revealed the group used the Gaza ceasefire period to train new fighters. The document outlined a compressed seven-day training course for 121 recruits in Hamas's Shejaia Battalion.

stories.title: Oil prices fall after Trump pauses planned Iran attack
stories.summary: Oil prices fell more than one percent after US President Donald Trump announced he had paused a planned attack on Iran to allow negotiations. Brent crude dropped to just above $110 per barrel amid market concerns over the continued closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Navy, Marine Corps back longer amphib readiness cycles, request more ships
stories.summary: The U.S. Navy and Marine Corps are advocating for longer amphibious ship readiness cycles, proposing to extend the current 36-month Optimized Fleet Response Plan to 56 months. Military leaders are also requesting additional amphibious vessels.

stories.title: AIIB to provide $320m loan for N-5 highway reconstruction project
stories.summary: Pakistan and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank signed a $320 million loan agreement for reconstruction and improvement of critical sections of the N-5 highway, the country's longest national highway running from Karachi to Torkham near the Afghan border.

stories.title: Joint Nigeria-US strikes kill 175 Islamic State group fighters, both militaries say
stories.summary: Joint Nigerian-U.S. military strikes killed approximately 175 Islamic State group fighters in northeastern Nigeria in recent days, according to both militaries. The United States deployed troops to Nigeria in February as armed groups intensified attacks on communities across the country.

stories.title: Does Ukraine have the advantage at the moment?
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces carried out a large-scale attack on the Moscow region, taking the war deeper into Russian territory as Kyiv seeks to press a battlefield advantage.

stories.title: Russian troops attack Dnipropetrovsk region more than 50 times since morning, injuring three people
stories.summary: Russian forces carried out more than 50 attacks on the Nikopol and Synelnykove districts of Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region throughout the day, wounding three people.

stories.title: Singer Patrick Bruel denies wave of sexual assault allegations in France
stories.summary: French-born singer Patrick Bruel denied a wave of sexual assault allegations in France. Among the accusers is TV and radio presenter Flavie Flament, who alleges Bruel raped her in 1991.

stories.title: Mansour Kaziha, Nader Awad identified as victims in San Diego Mosque attack
stories.summary: Authorities identified Mansour Kaziha and Nader Awad as two of the three victims killed in an attack at the Islamic Center of San Diego, California. The incident is being investigated as a hate crime.

stories.title: Rubio to attend Nato meeting amid concerns over US troop plans in Europe
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is set to attend a NATO foreign ministers meeting in Helsingborg, Sweden, amid growing concerns over reported US plans to reduce troop levels in Europe. Rubio will also travel to India afterward.

stories.title: Romanian jet shoots down suspected Ukrainian drone over Estonia
stories.summary: A Romanian military aircraft intercepted and shot down a suspected Ukrainian drone over Estonian territory. An investigation is underway to determine the drone's origin and the circumstances of the incident.

stories.title: Russia holds massive drills of nuclear forces as Ukraine steps up drone attacks
stories.summary: Russia launched three-day nuclear force exercises involving troops, submarines, and missile systems amid escalating tensions with Ukraine. The drills come as Ukraine has stepped up drone attacks on Russian territory.

stories.title: What Does Putin Want From Xi?
stories.summary: Russian President Putin traveled to Beijing for a summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping, seeking to resolve several bilateral trade issues. Analysts note that China holds significant leverage in the negotiations.

stories.title: FIA suspends two officers, registers case over incident in Karachi's Sarafa Bazaar
stories.summary: The FIA Karachi Zone suspended two officers and registered a case against a private individual following a raid on a jewellery shop in Karachi's Sarafa Bazaar, after FIA Director General Dr Usman Anwar ordered a full inquiry.

stories.title: Ukraine shows sea drone carrying 27 AI-guided interceptors built to kill Russia’s Shaheds in air
stories.summary: Ukraine unveiled the Katran X1.2, a nine-meter-long sea drone powered by a 350-horsepower engine and carrying 27 AI-guided interceptors designed to shoot down Russian-supplied Shahed drones.

stories.title: War in pieces: Air Force wants special ops plane that can be built on the fly
stories.summary: The US Air Force is pursuing the Skyraider II, a militarized version of the AT-802 crop duster aircraft, designed to provide overhead surveillance and close air support for isolated special operations teams in remote environments.

stories.title: Security forces kill 22 terrorists in North Waziristan operation: ISPR
stories.summary: Pakistani security forces killed 22 militants described as India-sponsored terrorists during an area sanitization operation in North Waziristan's Shewa area, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, according to the ISPR. The operation, launched on May 17, targeted members of the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan.

stories.title: Damage to Russian air defense system recorded near Mariupol
stories.summary: Petro Andriushchenko, head of the Center for the Study of Occupation, published photographs showing damage to a Russian air defense system near occupied Mariupol in southeastern Ukraine.

stories.title: Israel said preparing for renewal of Iran war; Trump says Tehran has days to make deal
stories.summary: Reports indicate Israel is preparing for a possible renewal of military action against Iran, with signs including a five-hour cabinet meeting and cancellation of the prime minister's trial hearing. President Trump stated Tehran has days to reach a deal.

stories.title: Mourning IDF veteran slain by police, alienated Bedouin say community souring on state
stories.summary: Bedouin community members in Israel are mourning an IDF veteran killed by police, expressing deepening distrust of Border Police. Younger Bedouin reportedly show growing estrangement from the state amid claims of worsening discrimination.

stories.title: Trump backs Paxton over Cornyn for Texas senator in shock endorsement
stories.summary: President Donald Trump endorsed Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton in the Republican Senate primary runoff against incumbent Senator John Cornyn. The endorsement was posted on social media shortly after early voting began, surprising political observers with its timing.

stories.title: 'Russia and China share same goal in constructing alternative world order', analyst says
stories.summary: Rex Li, a professor at King's College London, told FRANCE 24 that Russia and China share the goal of building a multipolar world and constructing an alternative world order. He noted that Vladimir Putin received a warmer reception from Chinese leaders compared to Donald Trump.

stories.title: EU pledges support for farmers hit by fertiliser price surge
stories.summary: The European Union has pledged exceptional support for farmers affected by surging fertiliser prices linked to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. Nearly half of globally traded urea passes through the waterway from Gulf states.

stories.title: Trump’s Gaza board reports funding ‘gap’, urges quicker disbursement
stories.summary: The U.S. Board of Peace, established by President Trump to oversee his plan to end Israel's war in Gaza, reported a funding gap and urged quicker disbursement of resources.

stories.title: Andy Burnham to face Reform’s Robert Kenyon in crucial Makerfield byelection
stories.summary: Andy Burnham will contest the Makerfield byelection near Wigan against Reform UK candidate Robert Kenyon, a plumber and army reservist. Reform UK is framing the contest as a local champion versus a career politician, with the outcome seen as potentially significant for British politics.

stories.title: Yishai Ishi Ron: Ex-commando writes novels about trauma and recovery
stories.summary: Israeli author and former commando Yishai Ishi Ron discussed how writing about PTSD and trauma aided his recovery. His award-winning novel 'Dog' explores themes of trauma and healing.

stories.title: Lula tops Brazil poll after report linking Bolsonaro to disgraced banker
stories.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva led Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in the first major poll for this year's presidential election. The survey followed a report alleging ties between the right-wing challenger and a disgraced banker.

stories.title: Hegseth impersonates Trump at rally: ‘Gonna have to be tough as sh*t’
stories.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth impersonated President Trump at a rally, recounting being offered the defense secretary position. The performance drew applause and laughter from attendees.

stories.title: Wounded warriors can wait months for evacuation. Ukrainians are trying to solve this—here’s how
stories.summary: Ukrainian developers are working on solutions including unmanned ground vehicles and experimental hexcopters to speed up battlefield medical evacuations, addressing wait times that can stretch to months for wounded soldiers.

stories.title: Russians attack rescue vehicle twice with drones in Nikopol
stories.summary: Russian military forces struck a fire truck twice with FPV drones in Nikopol, Dnipropetrovsk region, targeting a rescue vehicle responding to emergencies in the area.

stories.title: Explosions heard on Iran’s Qeshm island due to disposal of enemy ammunition
stories.summary: Explosions on Iran's Qeshm island on Tuesday were attributed to the neutralization of unexploded enemy ammunition, according to Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency citing a local official.

stories.title: Ebola deaths in eastern Congo rise to 131, WHO voices deep concern
stories.summary: The Ebola death toll in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo rose to 131, with 26 more suspected deaths recorded in 24 hours. WHO Director-General expressed deep concern about the outbreak's spread in the Bunia region.

stories.title: Estonia says NATO shoots down suspected Ukrainian drone
stories.summary: A NATO military jet shot down a suspected Ukrainian drone over Estonia on Tuesday, according to Estonian authorities. The incident is the latest in a series of airspace violations in the Baltic region linked to Ukrainian attacks on neighboring Russia.

stories.title: Acting US attorney general defends fund for prosecuted Trump allies
stories.summary: Acting US Attorney General Todd Blanche defended a nearly $1.8 billion fund to compensate political allies of President Trump who claim they were unfairly prosecuted under the Biden administration. Democratic senators criticized the fund as a corrupt "slush fund" during committee testimony.

stories.title: Senator Bill Cassidy says he has no regrets over Trump impeachment vote after Louisiana loss
stories.summary: Republican Senator Bill Cassidy of Louisiana said he has no regrets about voting to convict Donald Trump during the 2021 impeachment trial, despite losing his primary re-election bid. Cassidy told reporters at the US Capitol that he had "the privilege of voting to uphold the constitution."

stories.title: Four bodies recovered after Israeli strike in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Four bodies were recovered following an Israeli strike on Deir Qanoun al-Nahr in the Tyre district of southern Lebanon. More than 10 people, including women and children, were reportedly wounded. Rescue operations are ongoing.

stories.title: 'Liquid on lips': Noughty makes premium alcohol-free wine really nice & 'appealing to wine drinkers'
stories.summary: Amanda Thomson, a former BBC correspondent, founded Noughty in 2019 as a premium alcohol-free wine brand. The company aims to offer wine lovers a high-quality non-alcoholic alternative, positioning itself within a growing shift in the wine industry.

stories.title: Paramount expresses support for CBS News leader Bari Weiss amid criticism
stories.summary: Paramount issued a statement supporting CBS News editor-in-chief Bari Weiss amid controversies and declining ratings on some programs. The statement followed reports that senior leadership had discussed reducing Weiss's oversight role at CBS News and potentially CNN.

stories.title: Estonia says Nato jet shot down drone over its territory
stories.summary: Estonia reported that a NATO jet shot down a drone over Estonian territory. Estonian authorities suspect the drone was a Ukrainian projectile that went off course after being disrupted by Russian electronic jamming.

stories.title: Israeli far-right finance minister says ICC prosecutor seeks his arrest
stories.summary: Israeli far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich said the ICC prosecutor has submitted a secret request for an international arrest warrant against him. He vowed retaliation by waging a campaign against the Palestinian Authority.

stories.title: Russian troops attack Zaporizhzhia, leaving houses, industrial facility damaged
stories.summary: A Russian attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia damaged private homes and an industrial facility in the area.

stories.title: Nigeria: AfDB Approves $200m Facility for Nigeria's Bank of Industry
stories.summary: The African Development Bank approved a $200 million financing facility for Nigeria's Bank of Industry to expand long-term credit access for companies in sectors linked to industrial growth.

stories.title: Iran hosts mass weddings for couples who signed up for ‘self-sacrifice’ in war against Israel
stories.summary: Iran held mass weddings for couples who enrolled in a "self-sacrifice" program as part of the war against Israel. Participants agreed to carry out actions such as forming human chains around power stations and other critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Israeli forces fire ‘rubber bullets’ at activists on Gaza aid flotilla
stories.summary: Israeli naval forces reportedly fired rubber bullets at activists aboard the Global Sumud Flotilla, a Gaza-bound aid vessel, during an interception at sea.

stories.title: Russian missile, drone strikes kill four in Ukraine's northern regions, officials say
stories.summary: Russian missile and drone strikes hit Ukraine's Chernihiv and Sumy regions, killing four civilians and damaging infrastructure, according to Ukrainian officials.

stories.title: Musk’s failed court attack on OpenAI could leave lasting scars on CEO Altman’s reputation
stories.summary: A federal jury ruled against Elon Musk in his lawsuit against OpenAI, with witnesses describing CEO Sam Altman as an untrustworthy leader during testimony. Despite the reputational scrutiny Altman faced during the trial, the court found Musk had filed his claims too late.

stories.title: WHO warns of "magnitude and speed" of Ebola outbreak in Congo with 131 deaths and cases in Uganda
stories.summary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the World Health Assembly in Geneva about the alarming speed of an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, citing over 543 suspected cases and 131 deaths. Two confirmed cases involving Congolese nationals were also reported in neighboring Uganda.

stories.title: High prices in Iran’s stunted housing market leave tenants with few options
stories.summary: Tenants in Iran face limited housing options as high prices and economic uncertainty persist, compounded by the possibility of renewed military conflict.

stories.title: Iran has mapped out US flight patterns for air defence: Report
stories.summary: Iran has reportedly mapped out US military flight patterns with Russian assistance, potentially improving the effectiveness of its air defence systems. An Iranian official indicated this intelligence could help Tehran better deploy systems such as the S-300.

stories.title: Explosions heard in Iran's Qeshm island due to disposal of enemy ammunition
stories.summary: Explosions were heard on Iran's Qeshm island, which Iranian media attributed to the disposal of unexploded enemy ammunition. The incident occurred days after U.S. President Donald Trump paused plans for renewed strikes on Iran.

stories.title: Russians covertly trained by China return to fight in Ukraine, sources say
stories.summary: Sources report that Russian personnel covertly trained by China have returned to fight in Ukraine, indicating China's involvement in the war is more direct than previously known.

stories.title: IAEA chief to brief UN Security Council on UAE nuclear plant attack
stories.summary: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi will brief the UN Security Council on a recent drone attack targeting the Barakah nuclear plant in the UAE's Al Dhafra region. The attack caused a fire in an electrical generator outside the plant's inner perimeter. The UAE's defence ministry said the drones originated from Iraqi territory.

stories.title: Israel military issues fresh evacuation warnings for South Lebanon
stories.summary: The Israel Defence Forces issued new evacuation warnings for residents in parts of southern Lebanon amid ongoing cross-border military operations and escalating tensions in the region.

stories.title: Trump’s Board of Peace urges fix to ‘gap’ in funding
stories.summary: The Trump-affiliated Board of Peace, a UN-approved body, has called attention to a funding gap, noting that pledged financial support for Gaza has not been delivered despite urgent humanitarian needs.

stories.title: Reuters: About 200 Russian troops secretly trained in China, the first known case since the war began
stories.summary: Reuters reported that approximately 200 Russian military personnel trained in China in late 2025 under a secret bilateral agreement, citing documents and sources in three European intelligence services. This is the first known instance of such training since the war began.

stories.title: Trump turns to Middle East allies as deal to end Iran war proves elusive
stories.summary: President Trump indicated he postponed a planned strike on Iran to allow diplomatic talks to continue, though no peace deal appears imminent. The US is increasingly relying on Middle East allies to help shape policy as efforts to end the Iran conflict and reopen global shipping lanes stall.

stories.title: Married at First Sight contestants urged to contact police over rape allegations
stories.summary: Metropolitan Police urged potential victims of sexual assault who appeared on the reality show Married at First Sight UK to come forward following allegations aired in a BBC Panorama episode. Two unnamed women alleged rape by their on-screen husbands, and a third contestant publicly accused her on-screen husband of misconduct.

stories.title: Rubio criticizes WHO’s Ebola response as US continues sweeping public health cuts
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio criticized the World Health Organization for being slow to identify the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. His remarks came as the US continues implementing broad cuts to public health funding and programs.

stories.title: Putin lands in China for trip that aims to show unshakeable ties after Trump pomp
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in Beijing on Tuesday for talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping. The visit, coming days after Donald Trump's trip to China, is intended to demonstrate the strength of Russia-China relations.

stories.title: Somaliland embassy to be based in Jerusalem, newly inaugurated ambassador says
stories.summary: Somaliland's newly inaugurated ambassador confirmed the country's embassy will be based in Jerusalem, while Israel will establish its embassy in Hargeisa, reflecting growing diplomatic and strategic ties between the two.

stories.title: Why is Israel building these long barriers inside Gaza?
stories.summary: BBC Verify has found Israel has been building a series of earth barriers inside Gaza since the October ceasefire.

stories.title: PAA extends airspace ban on Indian aircraft until June 24
stories.summary: The Pakistan Airports Authority extended its ban on Indian civilian and military aircraft using Pakistani airspace until June 24. The restriction, which took effect on May 19, continues to bar all Indian-registered aircraft and those operated or owned by Indian airlines.

stories.title: War update: 63 clashes on front line since morning, Pokrovsk sector remains most active
stories.summary: Since the morning, 63 combat engagements occurred along the front line between Ukrainian and Russian forces, with the Pokrovsk sector in the Donetsk region seeing the heaviest fighting.

stories.title: DRC prepares Ebola treatment centres as death toll rises
stories.summary: Health workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are restoring Ebola treatment centres as the death toll from the outbreak continues to rise.

stories.title: Kenya transport strike over fuel price hikes suspended for one week
stories.summary: Kenya's government announced on Tuesday that a public transport strike protesting fuel price hikes linked to the Iran war would be suspended for one week. The decision came after four people were killed in protests across the country the previous day.

stories.title: Who Is Yana Lantratova, Russia’s New Human Rights Commissioner?
stories.summary: Yana Lantratova was appointed as Russia's new Human Rights Commissioner. Rights defenders described her as a young careerist shaped entirely by the current political system, distinguishing her from her predecessor.

stories.title: US again avoids taking responsibility for Iran school attack that killed 155
stories.summary: Admiral Brad Cooper, commander of US Central Command, told a congressional panel that the investigation into a strike on an Iranian school that killed 155 people remains ongoing. Cooper cited the school's location on an IRGC cruise missile base as complicating the probe, while declining to assign responsibility.

stories.title: Venezuela Says It is Fighting Organized Crime. Is It?
stories.summary: Following the capture and extradition of Nicolás Maduro by US military forces, Venezuelan interim President Delcy Rodríguez has sought to balance US demands with longstanding criminal alliances. InSight Crime assesses her administration's efforts to address organized crime in Venezuela.

stories.title: Navy’s MQ-25 Stingray gets green light for low-rate initial production
stories.summary: The US Navy approved low-rate initial production for the MQ-25 Stingray unmanned refueling aircraft. A contract for three aircraft is expected to be awarded this summer.

stories.title: MQ-25A Stingray cleared for deployment, says Cao
stories.summary: The US Navy's MQ-25A Stingray unmanned aerial refueling drone has been cleared for deployment. The aircraft is designed to refuel carrier-based aircraft, freeing F/A-18E/F Super Hornets from tanking duties to focus on strike missions.

stories.title: Taijul puts Bangladesh on brink of Test series win over Pakistan
stories.summary: Bangladesh moved to the brink of a historic first-ever home Test series win over Pakistan after spinner Taijul Islam took 4-113 on day four in Sylhet. Pakistan ended on 316-7, needing 121 more runs in what would be a record chase of 437.

stories.title: Israeli TV leak exposes 'secret plan' to seize Iran uranium
stories.summary: An Israeli TV channel, the pro-Netanyahu Channel 14, broadcast details of a reported secret plan to seize enriched uranium from a site near Isfahan, Iran. The leak prompted outrage from Israeli opposition politicians.

stories.title: Pedro Almodóvar chases elusive Palme d’Or as Andy García returns to Cannes with noir passion project
stories.summary: Spanish director Pedro Almodóvar is competing for the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival with "Bitter Christmas," a drama about filmmaking and mental collapse. Russian director Andrey Zvyagintsev premiered "Minotaur," while Andy García debuted his noir film "Diamond" starring Vicky Krieps and Brendan Fraser.

stories.title: In pictures: Iran stages mass weddings for couples ready for war 'sacrifice'
stories.summary: Iranian authorities held mass public weddings in Tehran for couples who declared readiness to sacrifice their lives in the war against the United States and Israel. The state-sponsored ceremonies involved hundreds of couples across several major squares and were broadcast on state TV to boost wartime morale.

stories.title: US, Iran trade threats as Tehran stages mass weddings for couples ready for 'sacrifice'
stories.summary: President Trump warned Tuesday that the US may strike Iran again, while Tehran's military threatened to open "new fronts" in response. Iranian authorities held state-sponsored mass public weddings in Tehran for couples who declared readiness to sacrifice their lives in the war against the US and Israel.

stories.title: US sanctions activists aboard Gaza-bound aid flotilla
stories.summary: The US Treasury Department sanctioned four activists aboard a Gaza-bound aid flotilla organized by the Popular Conference for Palestinians Abroad. Israel intercepted dozens of aid vessels after more than 50 ships departed from the Turkish port of Marmaris. Those sanctioned include European activists Saif Abu Keshek, Jaldia Abubakra Aueda, and others.

stories.title: Europol intercepts tens-of-thousands of incidents tied to IRGC-related terrorist content
stories.summary: Europol intercepted tens of thousands of incidents linked to online terrorist content associated with Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. The IRGC, designated a terrorist organization by the EU in February, had been using online platforms to spread propaganda, recruit supporters, and raise funds.

stories.title: Trump backs Ken Paxton in crucial Texas Republican Senate run-off
stories.summary: Former President Donald Trump has endorsed Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton in a Republican Senate run-off, with polls showing a tight race between Paxton, incumbent John Cornyn, and Democrat James Talarico.

stories.title: Sweden to buy four frigates from France's Naval Group
stories.summary: Sweden announced it will purchase four frigates from France's Naval Group as part of a broader rearmament effort following Russia's war in Ukraine and Sweden's 2024 NATO accession. Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson called it one of Sweden's largest defense investments since the Gripen fighter jet program.

stories.title: Trump threatens ‘a big hit’ if Tehran does not make deal soon
stories.summary: President Donald Trump warned Tuesday that the US may launch new attacks on Iran if Tehran does not agree to significant concessions. Trump said he had been "an hour away" from ordering strikes that would have broken the existing ceasefire before pulling back.

stories.title: John Healey says Labour infighting puts government’s credibility at risk
stories.summary: UK Defence Secretary John Healey criticized Labour figures publicly positioning themselves for the party leadership, warning that internal infighting threatens the government's credibility. His remarks appeared directed at Andy Burnham, Wes Streeting, and junior defence minister Al Carns.

stories.title: France to return bodies of Indigenous people exhibited in colonial ‘human zoos’
stories.summary: The French Senate unanimously passed a bill to return the remains of Indigenous people from French Guiana who were exhibited in colonial-era "human zoos" in Paris. The legislation addresses a longstanding demand from Indigenous communities in France's overseas territories.

stories.title: Border guards show how they destroy Russian assault groups trying to break through in Kharkiv region
stories.summary: Fighters of Ukraine's Hart border brigade are eliminating small Russian assault groups attempting to cross the state border in the northern Kharkiv region, using defensive operations to repel incursions.

stories.title: Musk expands Israel ties with Tesla self-driving car rollout
stories.summary: Elon Musk expanded his business ties with Israel through the rollout of Tesla self-driving cars in the country. The move deepens his relationship with the Israeli government despite ongoing allegations of permitting antisemitic content on his platform X.

stories.title: IDF Home Front Command updates application's alert system for clarity in emergency situations
stories.summary: The IDF Home Front Command updated its mobile and smart TV alert system with color-coded warnings, dedicated sounds, and clearer instructions to help Israeli citizens respond more quickly during emergencies.

stories.title: Putin arrives in China for high-stakes talks with Xi Jinping
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in Beijing for talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping days after US President Trump concluded his own visit to China, making the summit closely watched by international observers.

stories.title: Navy greenlights low-rate production of drone refueler
stories.summary: The U.S. Navy has approved low-rate initial production of the MQ-25A Stingray unmanned aerial refueling drone. A contract for three aircraft is expected to be awarded this summer.

stories.title: Putin on the back foot? Russian president in China as Ukraine campaign stalls
stories.summary: Vladimir Putin visited Beijing days after Donald Trump's trip to China, with Russia seeking to demonstrate strong ties with its key partner. However, Xi Jinping showed no urgency to finalize the Power of Siberia 2 gas pipeline, which would double Russian gas exports to China.

stories.title: 2 killed, 11 injured in rain-related incidents in KP: PDMA
stories.summary: Two people were killed and 11 injured in rain-related incidents in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on Monday, according to the Provincial Disaster Management Authority. Deaths were reported in Mardan, while injuries occurred in Battagram, Mardan, and Swat, with multiple houses damaged.

stories.title: Minab school struck at start of Iran war was located on active missile base, CENTCOM chief says
stories.summary: CENTCOM chief stated that a girls' school in Minab, Iran, struck at the start of the US-Iran war was located on an active missile base. Reuters had previously reported that an internal US military investigation found US forces were likely responsible for the school's destruction.

stories.title: TTAP, PTI announces countrywide protests on Friday against Imran's imprisonment, rising inflation
stories.summary: Pakistan's opposition alliance TTAP and PTI announced countrywide protests for Friday against the imprisonment of former Prime Minister Imran Khan and rising inflation. The announcement was made by senior PTI leaders including former National Assembly speaker Asad Qaiser outside Parliament House in Islamabad.

stories.title: US lawmakers press Centcom chief over Iran war civilian deaths
stories.summary: Democratic Representative John Garamendi questioned CENTCOM chief Admiral Brad Cooper during a congressional hearing about whether hostilities between the US and Iran have truly ceased since last month's ceasefire announcement. Cooper maintained the US remained in a ceasefire despite recent attacks by both sides.

stories.title: 'Ebola has tortured us': Fear grips eastern DR Congo as deadly virus spreads
stories.summary: An Ebola outbreak is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, causing widespread fear. The DRC health minister acknowledged that medical responders were slow to detect the virus and are now playing catch-up.

stories.title: In Focus podcast | Why Trump is in a strategic gridlock over Iran?
stories.summary: A podcast episode examines President Trump's evolving posture toward Iran and the strategic constraints he faces. Analyst Stanly Johny discusses how Gulf powers are influencing U.S. decision-making behind the scenes regarding the Iran standoff.

stories.title: Beijing brushes off allegations Chinese ship hit by Russian drone
stories.summary: Beijing downplayed allegations that a Russian Shahed drone struck the Chinese cargo vessel KSL Deyang in the Black Sea. Ukraine had reported the incident, claiming the drone hit the Chinese ship. China's response brushed off the claims without elaborating.

stories.title: Estonian FM on drone incident: Ukraine has full right to strike Russian military targets
stories.summary: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna stated that Ukraine has full legal and moral right to strike Russian military targets, commenting after a drone incident over Estonian territory.

stories.title: Trump was 'an hour away' from a decision on Iran before being called to wait
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump said he was one hour away from ordering a military strike on Iran before several Middle Eastern governments called and asked him to wait several days to allow negotiations to continue.

stories.title: Israel assesses ICC will issue arrest warrants for five officials over Gaza war crime allegations
stories.summary: Israel assesses that the International Criminal Court will issue arrest warrants for five Israeli officials over allegations of war crimes in Gaza. Those expected to be named include Defense Minister Katz, Finance Minister Smotrich, National Security Minister Ben-Gvir, IDF Chief Zamir, and Southern Command Chief Yaniv Asor.

stories.title: Hungary's new Prime Minister Magyar seeks to fix Poland ties
stories.summary: Hungary's new Prime Minister Peter Magyar visited Warsaw seeking to repair relations with Poland. The trip marked his first state visit and an effort to rebuild ties strained under his predecessor.

stories.title: Hamas rejects Board of Peace report on Gaza truce stalling
stories.summary: Hamas rejected a report by the Trump-appointed Board of Peace that identified the group's refusal to disarm as the main obstacle to fully implementing the Gaza ceasefire.

stories.title: Somaliland to open embassy in Jerusalem, Israel in Hargeisa: Envoy
stories.summary: Somaliland has announced plans to open an embassy in Jerusalem, while Israel will establish an embassy in Hargeisa. The move follows Israel's official recognition of Somaliland's independence from Somalia.

stories.title: One year in, Army’s transformation efforts are under fire
stories.summary: One year into the U.S. Army's transformation efforts, the initiative faces scrutiny. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is reportedly reconsidering his directive to retire legacy systems in favor of newer technology.

stories.title: Police say extra funds to hunt grooming gangs in England and Wales will ‘likely fall short’
stories.summary: The UK government announced a near tenfold funding increase to £38 million for Operation Beaconport, which reviews closed group-based sexual exploitation cases in England and Wales. Police warned the amount will likely fall short of what is needed to establish dedicated grooming gang investigation teams.

stories.title: G7 to maintain sanctions pressure to prevent Russia from financing war against Ukraine – French minister
stories.summary: G7 finance ministers reaffirmed support for Ukraine and agreed to maintain sanctions pressure on Russia to prevent Moscow from generating revenues to finance its war effort, according to a French minister.

stories.title: Ukraine apologizes to Estonia after drone enters its airspace and is shot down by NATO fighter jets
stories.summary: Ukraine formally apologized to Estonia after a Ukrainian drone entered Estonian airspace and was shot down by a NATO fighter jet. Ukrainian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Heorhii Tykhyi issued the apology on social media.

stories.title: Putin arrives in China for talks with Chinese leader Xi Jinping
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in Beijing for talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, in a visit closely watched amid shifting global diplomacy.

stories.title: Suspected gunman in deadly shootings in southern Türkiye ends life as police close in during a major search effort
stories.summary: A 37-year-old suspect armed with a rifle killed his wife and five other people in Tarsus, Mersin Province, Turkey, on May 18, 2026, and wounded eight others. The suspect ended his own life as police closed in during a major search operation.

stories.title: Canada faces pressure over killing of citizen in Israeli strike on Lebanon
stories.summary: The Canadian government faces growing pressure to pursue accountability after citizen Hassan Haidar, a 38-year-old father of five from Windsor, Ontario, was killed in an Israeli drone strike on the village of Qana in southern Lebanon on April 10. Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand was questioned about Ottawa's decision to ask Israel to investigate the killing.

stories.title: In Berlin, ex-captive Alon Ohel plays piano in appreciation of support
stories.summary: Former Israeli captive and pianist Alon Ohel performed at an event hosted by the Israeli ambassador in Berlin. Ohel shared how music helped him survive his time in captivity.

stories.title: Somaliland’s first-ever embassy anywhere will open in Jerusalem, envoy says
stories.summary: A Somaliland diplomat announced that the breakaway East African state will open its first-ever embassy in Jerusalem. Israel is also expected to open an embassy in Somaliland's capital, Hargeisa.

stories.title: Big data AI startup will open Tel Aviv engineering hub to tap into local tech talent
stories.summary: US-based big data AI startup Fundamental announced plans to open an engineering hub in Tel Aviv to access local tech talent. The company intends to hire dozens of employees for its risk-prediction and trend-analysis platform.

stories.title: Norway reports Europe’s first case of bird flu in a polar bear
stories.summary: Norwegian authorities confirmed Europe's first documented case of bird flu in a polar bear, detected in the Svalbard archipelago in the Arctic. The H5N5 variant was found in a young male bear and a walrus discovered dead in mid-May, according to the Norwegian Veterinary Institute.

stories.title: Russian missile, drone strikes kill four in Ukraine's northern regions, officials say
stories.summary: Russian missile and drone strikes on Ukraine's northern Chernihiv and Sumy regions killed four people and injured several others on Tuesday. Ukrainian officials reported the attacks, which targeted civilian areas in the two regions bordering Russia.

stories.title: How the Iranian regime ensures civilians bear the burden of its war against the US, Israel
stories.summary: An analysis describes how the Iranian regime's policies ensure civilians bear disproportionate consequences of the war against the US and Israel. The system reportedly limits access to financial stability opportunities to those who subscribe to the state's religious governance framework of Velayat-e Faqih.

stories.title: US imposes sanctions on Gaza flotilla organisers amid Israeli crackdown
stories.summary: The United States has imposed sanctions on organisers of a Gaza-bound aid flotilla. Rights advocates have accused Washington of using terrorism designations to suppress pro-Palestinian activism internationally.

stories.title: Israel’s far-right Finance Minister Smotrich says ICC seeking his arrest
stories.summary: Israel's far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich stated that the International Criminal Court is seeking his arrest. Following the ICC warrant request, Smotrich threatened to displace Palestinians from the West Bank.

stories.title: Israeli minister Smotrich says ICC prosecutor seeking warrant for his arrest
stories.summary: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich stated that the ICC prosecutor is seeking an arrest warrant against him. The Hague-based International Criminal Court declined to comment, noting that warrant applications are classified as secret.

stories.title: Asian Reactions to Trump’s Summit with Xi
stories.summary: President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping held a summit in Beijing on May 14–15, discussing Iran, the Strait of Hormuz, Taiwan, and bilateral trade. Experts from Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and the Philippines offered perspectives on how the summit and its outcomes were received across Asia.

stories.title: Shield AI tapped to integrate autonomous software on LUCAS drone
stories.summary: Shield AI announced it will integrate its Hivemind autonomous software onto the LUCAS drone platform. The company plans to demonstrate the drone's swarming capability later this year.

stories.title: Diplomacy under fire: Where are Lebanon-Israel talks heading?
stories.summary: Lebanon-Israel negotiations continue amid a ceasefire extension, but familiar obstacles persist including Israeli maximalism and Lebanon's limited negotiating leverage. Questions remain about the US's effectiveness as a mediator in the talks.

stories.title: NS&I to contact bereaved families owed £367m after missing savings scandal
stories.summary: UK state-backed bank National Savings and Investments will begin contacting thousands of bereaved families next week who are owed a total of £367 million due to failures in tracing accounts of deceased customers. The bank's interim chief executive acknowledged the issue should never have occurred.

stories.title: British Airways delays Middle East flights until August
stories.summary: British Airways postponed the resumption of flights to Dubai, Doha, and Tel Aviv until August 1 due to continued instability in the Middle East. The airline also plans to reduce the number of flights to the region once operations resume.

stories.title: Tributes pour in for ‘hero’ guard killed in San Diego mosque shooting
stories.summary: Amin Abdullah, a security guard at the Islamic Centre of San Diego, was killed while attempting to stop gunmen from entering the mosque. Tributes have been paid to Abdullah, who has been called a hero.

stories.title: Official says Germany has already provided EUR 1.2B in energy sector support to Ukraine
stories.summary: Germany has provided more than EUR 1.2 billion in emergency support to Ukraine's energy sector, making it the largest bilateral donor in that field, according to an official statement.

stories.title: Surrey police launch investigation into UK Epstein abuse allegations
stories.summary: Surrey police in the UK have launched a criminal investigation into child sexual abuse allegations after two women came forward claiming they were victims of attacks detailed in the Epstein files. The allegations date back to the 1980s and 1990s, involving locations in Surrey and Berkshire.

stories.title: Iran starts Bitcoin-backed shipping insurance for Hormuz strait
stories.summary: Iran launched a Bitcoin-backed shipping insurance service called "Hormuz Safe" for the Strait of Hormuz. The service is designed for Iranian shipping companies and cargo owners navigating the strategic waterway.

stories.title: San Diego mosque guard hailed a hero after deadly shooting
stories.summary: A security guard at the Islamic Center in San Diego was hailed as a hero after being killed while attempting to stop gunmen during the deadly mosque shooting.

stories.title: Russian Director Andrey Zvyagintsev Returns to Cannes Film Festival After Near-Fatal Illness
stories.summary: Russian film director Andrey Zvyagintsev, known for "Leviathan" and "Loveless," returned to the Cannes Film Festival after a near-fatal illness. He had been left in a coma and unable to walk for a year following a severe reaction to Russia's Sputnik V vaccine in 2021.

stories.title: Three Toronto police officers charged with sexual assault in Barcelona
stories.summary: Three off-duty Toronto police officers were charged with sexual assault in Barcelona after allegedly attacking a sex worker in a taxi in the Ciutat Vella neighborhood on May 13, according to Catalan police.

stories.title: UK supermarkets urged to consider voluntary price caps on essential foods
stories.summary: The UK government urged supermarkets to consider voluntary price caps on essential food items to shield consumers from inflation driven by the Middle East conflict. Retailers rejected the proposal, arguing it was unjustified and could increase costs across the board amid rising taxes and energy prices.

stories.title: Police to seek criminal charges against 77 companies and people over Grenfell fire
stories.summary: London's Metropolitan Police announced plans to seek criminal charges against 77 companies and individuals in connection with the Grenfell Tower fire, which killed 72 people. A senior lawyer has been appointed to lead the prosecutions, though trials are not expected to begin until a decade after the 2017 disaster.

stories.title: More US troop withdrawals from Europe expected, NATO commander says
stories.summary: NATO Supreme Allied Commander Gen. Alexus Grynkewich said on Tuesday that Europe should expect additional U.S. troop withdrawals as allied nations take on greater responsibility for their own defense.

stories.title: Can Armenia’s Democracy Prevail?
stories.summary: Armenia's democratic governance faces challenges, with analysts warning that unconditional Western support for incumbent Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan could have unintended negative consequences for the country's democratic trajectory.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian command post in Pokrovsk
stories.summary: Operators from the Raid regiment of Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces struck a command post belonging to Russia's 9th Motor Rifle Brigade of the 51st Combined Arms Army in the occupied city of Pokrovsk in Donetsk Oblast.

stories.title: Trump says US could strike Iran again within days without deal
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump warned that the US could launch another military strike on Iran within days if no agreement is reached. Speaking at the White House, Trump claimed Tehran was eager to negotiate and stressed the urgency of preventing Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons.

stories.title: Trump endorses attorney general Ken Paxton in Texas Senate primary
stories.summary: President Trump endorsed Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton in the Republican Senate primary runoff against incumbent Senator John Cornyn. Trump praised Paxton as an "America First Patriot" in a social media post on Tuesday.

stories.title: Rescuers search for three missing after German building collapse possibly caused by gas explosion
stories.summary: Emergency crews in Germany continued searching for three missing people after a building collapse reportedly triggered by a suspected gas explosion. Several other people were injured in the incident.

stories.title: Trump says Xi assured him China would not send weapons to Iran
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump said Chinese President Xi Jinping assured him that China would not send weapons to Iran. Trump also warned he could strike Iran again if progress on a ceasefire is not achieved within days.

stories.title: US wants Ukraine’s AI-assisted targeting, GPS-free navigation, and IP to reproduce it, but Zelenskyy has red line
stories.summary: Ukraine plans to produce three million attack drones in 2025, while the United States—having built 300,000 last year—is seeking access to Ukrainian AI-assisted targeting, GPS-free navigation, and related intellectual property to replicate the technology. President Zelenskyy has set limits on technology transfers.

stories.title: In 65% of JWed’s 4,100+ marriages, Jewish women made the first move - Sponsored Content
stories.summary: Jewish dating platform JWed reported that in 65% of its more than 4,100 marriages, women initiated contact first. The service has operated for over 25 years, helping Jewish singles connect.

stories.title: Death toll from Russian strike on Pryluky rises to three, 29 injured
stories.summary: A Russian ballistic missile struck the central part of Pryluky, Ukraine, killing three people including a 15-year-old boy who later died in hospital. Twenty-nine others were injured in the attack.

stories.title: Israel Air Force introduces all-women Arad special commando unit
stories.summary: The Israel Air Force established an all-women special commando unit called "Arad," created as an intervention force based on lessons learned from the October 7 massacre and Operation Iron Swords.

stories.title: Woman shot dead by police in Jamaica at protest over previous police shooting
stories.summary: Jamaican authorities launched an investigation after a police officer fatally shot 45-year-old Latoya Bulgin during a protest in Granville, St. James parish, on Sunday. CCTV footage circulating online shows the officer firing at the vehicle Bulgin was driving during a demonstration over a previous police shooting.

stories.title: Israel orders evacuations in 12 towns in south Lebanon
stories.summary: Israeli military spokesperson Avichay Adraee issued evacuation orders to residents of 12 towns and villages in southern Lebanon ahead of anticipated Israeli attacks. The warnings came despite a ceasefire that took effect the previous month.

stories.title: Trades of Eli Lilly shares were made on Trump’s behalf as drugmaker benefited from his policies
stories.summary: Financial disclosures revealed that trades worth between $220 million and $750 million were made on President Trump's behalf in the first quarter of 2026, including investments in Eli Lilly. The drugmaker had benefited from the administration's move to expand access to its obesity treatments.

stories.title: From battlefield to backyard: Inside Israel's Cando drone revolution
stories.summary: Israeli company Cando is developing drone technology for civilian applications, including potential organ delivery. CEO Ghil Hardy outlined the company's vision of transitioning military drone expertise to everyday domestic uses.

stories.title: Iran stages mass weddings for couples pledging to sacrifices lives in war with US, Israel
stories.summary: Iran held mass weddings in Tehran for couples who pledged to sacrifice their lives in the war against the US and Israel. More than 100 couples arrived at Imam Hossein Square in military jeeps with mounted machine guns and were wed on stage by a cleric.

stories.title: Liberman says his goal for the upcoming election is to become prime minister
